items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Dave Barry, the guy that refereed the Dempsey fight, he was the doorman with the rope across.

ctx.x: And they liked it in that time.

From then on, it was it. We had it made. And that was the first place that I ever know of where they put a cover charge on. Dave Barry, the guy that refereed the Dempsey fight, he was the doorman with the rope across. Because he came down the basement, see? And they put 10 cent cover charge on you. Keep the riffraff out. Now, you know that for a dime? To me, that was a funny thing, because I've been in places since. It cost you 2 and a half to get in.
Yeah, that's no cover charge. Yeah, 10 cents. 10 cents.
